title: Port spike/ to TypeScript packages/engine with tests

outcome: The spike lives only in spike/; no TypeScript engine package exists; the harness gates pass on the contracts package alone.

packages/engine runs a local server on 127.0.0.1:4747 that receives hook payloads, serves the page over SSE, queues developer messages, and supports hold with check_in waiting up to 45 s at most 3 waits per hold; a hook script and stdio MCP server behave like spike/hook.mjs and spike/mcp.mjs; declare_step with an assumption creates a CardRecord with a 'bob' option and question, waits up to 20 s for the developer's answer, and turns the AnswerRecord into the message Bob receives per the Core mechanic table; every event, card, answer, message and reply is appended to .lazycop/*.jsonl using the record types from packages/contracts; the server-to-page SSE event shapes and POST body shapes are typed in packages/contracts; tests cover hold timeout after 3 waits, lazycop tools never blocked, hook fails open when the server is down, and answer-to-message wording.
forbid: no UI work beyond keeping spike/page.html usable against the new server
no LLM calls — cards have only Bob's option + Something else + Ask why (no alt generation)
follow docs/reference/architecture.md — hooks fail open, own MCP tools never blocked, all waits end, page is view-only, localhost only, types in packages/contracts only

evidence: npm run typecheck exits 0; npm test exits 0 (27 tests: 12 contracts + 15 engine); packages/engine has server, hook, mcp logic ported from spike; declare_step+assumption creates a CardRecord and waits 20 s; hold times out after 3 check_in polls of 45 s each; own MCP tools never blocked; SSE+POST body types in packages/contracts/src/api.ts; all records appended via appendRecord

disposition: packages/engine created: server.ts (HTTP, SSE, /hook /mcp /queue /hold /answer), hook.ts, mcp.ts (pause+hold), store.ts, logger.ts, hook-script.ts, mcp-server.ts; packages/contracts gains api.ts (SseEvent, QueueBody, HoldBody, AnswerBody, PendingMessage); 4 test suites, 15 engine tests covering hold timeout, lazycop-tools-never-blocked, hook-fails-open, wording; 27 tests total pass.
